_readme: UVA places + nicknames, checked before calling Google. Add nicknames to 'aliases' freely (capitals, spaces, dashes don't matter). For a NEW place, add an entry without 'location' and run: npm run places. 'query' is what we ask Google to find it. Check the printed results; if a place lands wrong, fix its 'query' and run: npm run places -- <id>
